# AskEARN

> AskEARN is the Employer Assistance and Resource Network on Disability, providing comprehensive guidance on recruiting, hiring, retaining, and advancing employees with disabilities.

AskEARN, operated by EARN in partnership with Cornell University and the U.S. Department of Labor, offers evidence-based resources and the Disability@Work Framework to help employers build inclusive workplaces. The site serves employers, job seekers, and service providers with practical tools, training, and publications on disability employment practices.

## Core Resources

- [Home](https://askearn.org): AskEARN homepage introducing EARN's disability employment resources
- [About EARN](https://askearn.org/page/1): Overview of EARN organization and Disability@Work Framework
- [Resource Library](https://askearn.org/topics): Directory of disability employment resources and guides
- [Disability@Work: A Framework for Employing People with Disabilities](https://askearn.org/page/19): Comprehensive framework for disability employment strategies
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://askearn.org/faqs): FAQs on disability employment, accommodations, and disclosure

## Employer Guidance

- [Getting Started](https://askearn.org/page/66): Introduction guide to EARN resources and Disability@Work Framework
- [Recruit](https://askearn.org/page/60): Guide on recruiting employees with disabilities
- [Hire](https://askearn.org/page/67): Guidance on hiring practices for federal contractors and agencies
- [Retain](https://askearn.org/page/72): Strategies for retaining employees with disabilities
- [Advance](https://askearn.org/page/73): Career advancement and professional development guidance

## Training & Learning

- [Dinah Cohen Learning Center](https://askearn.org/page/71): Training resources and webinar archive for employers
